name: pathify-intelligence-engine
title: Pathify Intelligence Engine — Multi-Vertical Opportunity Scraper
description: MVP 5 sources: YC Jobs, Work at a Startup, Devpost (hackathons), Opportunity Desk (fellowships/grants/scholarships), Eventbrite (conferences/events). Extracts opportunities across jobs (remote/hybrid/onsite), internships, conferences, fellowships, events, startup funding/grants, scholarships & hackathons. Enriches with hybrid skill extraction (taxonomy + embedding/LLM fallback) and weighted match scoring. Dataset → Supabase cache → Pathify frontend.

meta.seoDescription: Production actor for Pathify — aggregates all opportunity verticals with intelligence layer.

startUrls.title: Start URLs
startUrls.description: Seed URLs to crawl. Leave empty to use defaults for selected opportunity types (MVP 5).

opportunityTypes.title: Opportunity Types
opportunityTypes.description: Filter which verticals to scrape. If empty, scrapes all MVP 5.

userSkills.title: User Skills
userSkills.description: Skills to score matches against (e.g., React, Python). Used for match_score/matched_skills/skill_gap.

location.title: Location Filter
location.description: Free-text location hint (e.g., 'Lagos', 'Global / Remote'). Stored on records, not yet filtering crawl.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy Configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Apify Proxy to avoid blocking. Recommended useApifyProxy:true.

useLLM.title: Enable LLM Fallback (Best)
useLLM.description: When true, low-confidence items call Gemini/OpenAI for skill extraction. Uses API key from env LLM_API_KEY. Costs apply; cached by description hash.

enqueueLinks.title: Follow Pagination/Links
enqueueLinks.description: If true, enqueues detail pages and pagination via Crawlee. Disable for single-page fast runs.
